title: One Line a Night
transcript: I tried keeping a diary in secondary school, but I gave it up because I thought every entry had to fill a page. Years later, I started again using a wall calendar. Before bed, I write just one line about something worth remembering. On ordinary days, I might note a joke from work or a meal I enjoyed. After a few months, I found that even very short notes could bring back whole conversations. The smaller task is easier to keep doing.

questions.prompt: Why did the speaker stop keeping a diary at school?
options: There was nothing to write about.
Each entry seemed to require too much writing.
A teacher asked the speaker to stop.
questions.answer: Each entry seemed to require too much writing.
questions.explanation: 当时认为每篇必须写满一页，负担太大。

questions.prompt: What can a short note help the speaker do?
questions.explanation: 短短的记录也能唤起对整段对话的回忆。
